concepts.label: Material Discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

summary: Defines a material discrepancy as any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

concepts.label: Material Discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

object_quote: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
object: any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity
summary: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity.
quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

concepts.label: Documenting Material Name Change
concepts.definition: Submission of acceptable documentation to substantiate a material name discrepancy.
concepts.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section

context_quotes: see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)
alternative_quotes:
Court orders or decrees:

(a) Name change orders; or

(b) Divorce decrees
Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law
choice_quote: submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
choice_text: One or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees (either name change orders or divorce decrees); (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
logic_text: one or more of the documents listed in this section
object_quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
object: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity
summary: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submitting one or more acceptable documents listed (court orders/decrees including name change orders or divorce decrees, certificates of naturalization, marriage certificates, documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law, or documentation of customary usage), subject to an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

action_quote: be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration
action: review for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration
summary: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration.
quote: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

scope_quotes: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
scope_text: Applies after a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
summary: The applicant must not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

action_quote: specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
action: specifically permit the applicant to continue using that name
applies_to: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).
summary: An exception to the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name applies if the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.
quote: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name

scope_quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity. Consequently
scope_text: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), given that the applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.
action_quote: be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
action: be required to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
summary: Under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
quote: evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:

typed_values.name: Time elapsed since material name change
typed_values.quote: more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11

scope_quotes: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change
scope_text: If the applicant had a material name change more than one year before applying on form DS-11 and has not updated her/his ID to reflect the change.
action_quote: suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name
action: suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name
summary: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, the adjudicator must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.
quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

scope_quotes: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change
If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel
scope_text: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID, and there is insufficient time to request acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.
action_quote: be issued in the requested name
summary: When an applicant had a material name change over one year prior to applying on Form DS-11 without updating ID, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name if there is insufficient time to request an acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel.
quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;

action_quote: need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID
action: need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID
summary: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.
quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

scope_quotes: prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL)
scope_text: Prior to returning the documentation, including notation that it was 'seen and returned', to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL).
summary: The adjudicator must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning it to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL), including noting that it was 'seen and returned'.
quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL);

typed_values.name: Time window since material name change
typed_values.quote: within one year of applying on a form DS-11

scope_quotes: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
scope_text: Applies to applicants who had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11.
actor_quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
actor: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
summary: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on form DS-11 are not required to submit ID in the new name.
quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

scope_quotes: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11
if the ID has not yet been changed
scope_text: For applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11, if the ID has not yet been changed.
summary: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on form DS-11 must submit their name change documentation if their ID has not yet been changed.
quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
